name: Termo Multiclasses (TER)
manual_section: 4.10.1 Registro de Contrato a Termo Sem CCP
description: Layout for the parties to register Currency Forward (Termo de Moedas) contracts, or forwards on other asset classes, in the Termo module (Termo21), without CCP. Positional file: one header line (type 0), one 'Dados Fixos' line (type 1) per contract, and optional 'Dados Variáveis' lines (type 2) carrying the verification dates of Asian-average contracts.
file_name_rule: App writes TCO_{LAWTON,BANCO}.txt (NDF Commodities) and FWDSTART_/OTHERPUBLISHER_{BANCO,LAWTON,MGT}.txt (generic NDF) into the Batch Conecta upload folder; a numeric suffix is added when the name already exists.
notes: Page 647 also carries 'Tabela I - Moedas Autorizadas para Registros de Contratos a Termo': a currency reference table (name, type A/B, country, ISO symbol, Sisbacen code, decimal places in registration — e.g. USD = 220 with 6 decimals, EUR = 978, JPY = 470, most currencies 8 decimals). It is reference data, not a record layout; in the app these codes come from the currency-base mapping (SIMBOLO → CODIGO DE CADASTRO). Two app generators produce TER files: the NDF Commodities one (asset class 4 = COMMODITIES) and the generic NDF one for FWD Start / Other Publisher (asset class 2 = TAXAS DE CÂMBIO); Vanilla vs Other Publisher routing is decided upstream by the publisher-ndf mapping (NOTES = BACEN).

In the app only the NDF Commodities generator emits these rows; the generic NDF generator sends only the count in field 59 of line type 1.

fields.source_note: Same verification date when Strike Currency is BRL, else blank. DIVERGES FROM THE MANUAL: the manual asks X(16) at 35-51 with the date right-aligned; production has always written the date LEFT-aligned in 8 chars plus a 10-space filler (18 chars, 35-52) and B3 accepts it — kept as production sends it
